# 0x7CA5D3 wcscmp 基准（batch 950）——纯内存操作零桩真身模拟
# 格式: CASE s1=<hex> s2=<hex> -> ret=<tri>  （s1/s2 为 u16 小端
# 字节序 hex，含尾 NUL；ret 三态 -1/0/+1）
CASE s1=0000 s2=0000 -> ret=0
CASE s1=0041004200430000 s2=0041004200430000 -> ret=0
CASE s1=0041004200430000 s2=0041004200440000 -> ret=-1
CASE s1=0041004200440000 s2=0041004200430000 -> ret=1
CASE s1=0041004200430000 s2=004100420000 -> ret=1
CASE s1=004100420000 s2=0041004200430000 -> ret=-1
CASE s1=0061006200630000 s2=0041004200430000 -> ret=1
CASE s1=0000 s2=00580000 -> ret=-1
CASE s1=00580000 s2=0000 -> ret=1
CASE s1=00300031003200330034003500360037003800390000 s2=00300031003200330034003500360037003800390000 -> ret=0
CASE s1=0100020000000300 s2=0100020003010000 -> ret=-1
CASE s1=0100020003010000 s2=0100020000000300 -> ret=1
CASE s1=ffff0000 s2=01000000 -> ret=1
CASE s1=01000000 s2=ffff0000 -> ret=-1
